craft_notes: TITLE-VERSE (svabodhasiddhi named; authorship 'by me' kept literal, identity unasserted). Sthāyin: telling-joy (colophon). Sanskrit first: purpose + four epithets + naming + agent → L4 sets purpose+epithets line 1, naming+agent line 2. Rows: row 1 (me-last — mayā closes as me closes). Rupture: dash after bright — praised, named. Close: end-weight on the teller (me — the voice, not the name). Minimal pass: 'spirit-bright' for citprakāśikā (consciousness-lighting sung). Read aloud: stainless, bright, true, mother — me. Rejected: naming Bhūtirāja — killed: text says 'by me', song says me; 'gospel' for siddhi — killed: accomplishment kept.

lines: Thus for the goal — stainless, spirit-bright,
mother of freedom: self-waking, as told by me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ittham upeyaprāptau vigatamalā citprakāśikā satyā / kaivalyabhūtijananī svabodhasiddhir mayā gaditā

reads_against.argmap: Thus for the goal: stainless, consciousness-lighting, true, freedom-mothering — the self-awakening-accomplishment told by me.
